get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:settings`

List the tenant's team members (any member of the tenant may call this). Supports free-text search (`q`, matches display name / name / email) and a result limit.

This endpoint also exposes an owner-only existence probe: calling it with `probe=existing-user` and an `email` returns `{ "exists": <boolean> }` indicating whether an account already exists for that email. The probe is restricted to owners (office and tech roles receive 403) because account existence is itself sensitive; supplying `probe=existing-user` without a valid `email` returns 400.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search query, matched against the member's display name, name, and email.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of members to return (defaults to 20).

parameters.name: probe
parameters.description: Owner-only existence probe. When set to `existing-user`, the response is `{ "exists": <boolean> }` instead of the member list, and `email` is required.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email to check existence for. Required when `probe=existing-user`.

200.description: The tenant's team members, or — when `probe=existing-user` was supplied — an existence result.

exists.description: Whether an account already exists for the probed email.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Owner role only (office and tech receive 403). Invites a teammate by email and role. A pending invitation is created and an invite email is sent; re-inviting the same email rotates the invitation token. If the email already belongs to a member of this tenant, returns 409 `already_member` and no email is sent. If the email matches an existing Zoop account in another tenant, the invitation is flagged `is_cross_tenant` and a sign-in (rather than sign-up) email is sent.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user id of the team member.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Owner role only (office and tech receive 403). Changes a member's role. The last remaining owner of a tenant cannot be demoted (returns 409 `last_owner_protected`). Requesting the role the member already has is an idempotent no-op (`changed: false`). When a member is moved out of `owner`, their admin-tier API keys are revoked as part of the same request.

200.description: The membership after the (possible) role change.

changed.description: False when the requested role matched the current role (no-op).

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Owner role only (office and tech receive 403). Removes a member from the tenant. The last remaining owner cannot be removed (returns 409 `last_owner_protected`). All of the removed member's API keys for this tenant are revoked as part of the same request.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Owner role only (office and tech receive 403). Lists the tenant's pending (not-yet-accepted) team invitations, most recently invited first.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Owner role only (office and tech receive 403). Hard-deletes a pending invitation; the invite link stops working. Returns 404 if the invitation does not exist or belongs to another tenant, and 410 `invitation_already_accepted` if the recipient has already accepted (remove the resulting member via `DELETE /team-members/{userId}` instead).

410.description: The invitation has already been accepted and cannot be revoked.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Owner role only (office and tech receive 403). Rotates the invitation token, pushes the expiry to 7 days out, and re-sends the invite email. The previous invite link stops working immediately. Returns 404 if the invitation does not exist or belongs to another tenant, and 410 `invitation_already_accepted` if the recipient has already accepted.

410.description: The invitation has already been accepted and cannot be resent.

TeamMemberRole.description: A team member's role within the tenant.

TeamMember.description: A team member of the tenant, as returned by the list endpoint (joined from the membership and the user account).

display_name.description: Display name, derived from the account's full name / name / email local-part, falling back to 'Unknown user'.

avatar_url.description: Avatar URL, or null when the account has none.

last_sign_in_at.description: When the member last signed in, or null if never.

TeamMembership.description: A membership record returned after a role update.

TeamMemberUpdate.description: Payload to change a member's role.

email.description: Email address to invite. Trimmed and validated as an email.

TeamMemberInvitation.description: An invitation as returned by the invite (POST) and resend endpoints.

expires_at.description: When the invitation expires (7 days from creation/rotation).

is_cross_tenant.description: True when the invited email already has a Zoop account in another tenant (a sign-in email is sent instead of sign-up). Present on the invite (POST) response; absent on the resend response.

TeamMemberPendingInvitation.description: A pending invitation as returned by the list-invitations endpoint.

invited_by_name.description: Display name of the inviter, derived from their account; 'Unknown user' if not resolvable.
